dataset: Sleep-EDF Expanded v1.0.0, sleep-cassette development subset
primary_C: K5 minus K1, condition A, equal weight between add_people and random
primary_D: V minus R, K1 BiGRU fixed, with ten draws per roster

neighbor_rule.boundary: Clamp to epoch 0 or last full PSG epoch. Complete missing in-range features from the frozen W4 checkpoint.
neighbor_rule.center_labels: Use only locked anchor or selected scorable centers for supervised loss.

head.weights: W4 step30000 ema_model frozen 384-D EEG/EOG feature cache
head.center_standardization: Mean and population standard deviation on supervised centers for each fitted unit
head.balanced_sampler: Uniform over present stages and then uniform over their supervised centers, with replacement, for n samples per epoch

analysis.evaluation: Frozen 41,498 centers, historical order of two eight-person subcohorts
analysis.macro_f1: Five-class Macro-F1 after pooling drawn participants' counts; equal roster weight
analysis.bootstrap_C: Common roster, both subcohort subject draws, and same sampled repeat across policies and heads
analysis.bootstrap_D: Common roster and subcohort subject draws, independent within-roster repeat draws per arm
analysis.membership_sensitivity: Independent Exp(1) weights for anchor participants; each roster receives the mean of its 5 participant weights, normalized across rosters. Draw counts and evaluation subjects as in the primary bootstrap. Leave one anchor participant's rosters out at a time.
